functional_requirements: Provide a flat mounting plate 100 mm x 50 mm with 5 mm stock thickness
Provide four 6 mm diameter through-holes for mounting/fasteners (clearance holes)
Each hole center must be located 10 mm from the two adjacent plate edges
Plate top and bottom faces must be flat and parallel
All holes must be through-holes passing fully through the 5 mm thickness
special_features: All four holes MUST be through-holes penetrating the full plate thickness along the Z axis (direction normal to the plate face), not blind holes and not oriented along X or Y
The four holes MUST be located at (X, Y) = (±HOLE_POS_X, ±HOLE_POS_Y) = (±40, ±15) in the centroid-origin frame, giving an EDGE_OFFSET_X = 10 mm and EDGE_OFFSET_Y = 10 mm to the adjacent plate edges
The hole pattern MUST be symmetric about both the XZ plane (Y coordinates mirror about Y=0) and the YZ plane (X coordinates mirror about X=0)
The plate outline MUST be a plain rectangle of PLATE_LENGTH_X by PLATE_WIDTH_Y with sharp (unfilleted) outer corners unless otherwise specified

The holes MUST NOT intersect each other or break through the outer plate edges — minimum remaining wall from hole edge to plate edge must be EDGE_OFFSET_X - HOLE_RADIUS = 7 mm (X) and EDGE_OFFSET_Y - HOLE_RADIUS = 7 mm (Y)
The bottom face of the plate MUST lie on Z=0 (base plane) with the origin at the XY centroid of that bottom face
The top and bottom faces of the plate MUST remain planar and parallel after the hole boolean operations
